title: Write-loop and token control fix for the single AgentSession architecture

architecture.path: interface -> eyle.runtime.service -> AgentSession -> LLM <-> tools/external memory -> response
architecture.external_memory: available only through memory_search and memory_store
architecture.planning: optional field authored by the same LLM
architecture.write_model: supervised dry-run, confirmation, apply, tests, rollback, reread

removed_from_ecosystem: engine package as a misleading reasoning layer
separate mission interpreter and mission repair
MissionSpec and overlapping agent state machines
action replay and semantic progress gates
ingest/index entry point without a live consumer
model-response cache and stale AgentSession decision replay
completion_gate and duplicated agent result envelopes
core-generated confirmation IDs and duplicated pending metadata
unused persistence, telemetry, imports, constants, and compatibility aliases

validation.skip_reason: Flask is not installed in the packaging environment

known_limits: The real Qwen smoke test must run in the deployment environment.
Flask is required only for the optional web interface.
Full-file replacement requires a fresh complete read; files larger than the configured read limit must use range updates.
Cross-language verification depends on available project tests and language-specific checks.
Multi-file rollback provides all-or-restored behavior but filesystems cannot atomically replace several files in one operation.
